meta.pos: noun; noun; noun; noun; noun; noun; verb; verb; verb; verb

defs.def: an object made of short stiff hairs (called bristles ) or wires set in a block of wood or plastic, usually attached to a handle. Brushes are used for many different jobs, such as cleaning, painting and tidying your hair. 刷子；毛刷；画笔

ex.s: But he did not know about brushes before a visitor told him he needed one.
ex.t: 但在一位访客告诉他需要一支之前，他还不知道画笔这回事。

ex.s: When he went home, he sent Benjamin a box of paint and some brushes.
ex.t: 回家后，他给本杰明寄了一盒颜料和一些画笔。

ex.s: These were the first pictures and first real paint and brushes Benjamin had  ever  seen.
ex.t: 这些是本杰明见过的第一批照片 和第一批真正的油漆和刷子

ex.s: Benjamin would have real brushes soon.
ex.t: 本杰明很快就要离开家了。

ex.s: In those days , a brush was made from camel’s hair.
ex.t: 在那个时候，画笔是用骆驼毛制成的。

ex.s: A recent project used technology and data in the same way that Rembrandt used his paints and brushes.
ex.t: 最近的一个项目以伦勃朗运用颜料和画笔的同样方式使用了技术和数据。

ex.s: A recent project used technology and data just like Rembrandt used his paints and brushes.
ex.t: 最近的一个项目使用技术和数据，就像伦勃朗使用他的颜料和画笔一样。

ex.s: The brush did not last long.
He cut some fur from the family cat to make a brush.
ex.t: 他从家里的猫身上剪下一些毛来做了一支画笔。

ex.s: Day after day, Han Gan painted the horses, his brush presenting every detail that he saw with his own eyes.
ex.t: 日复一日，韩干画着马，他的笔展现着亲眼所见的每一处细节。

defs.def: a light touch made in passing sth/sb 轻擦；掠过
a short unfriendly meeting with sb; an occasion when you nearly experience sth unpleasant 小冲突；稍有不快的场合

ex.s: The good news is that when that happens, we pick ourselves up, brush ourselves off, and get back to work.
ex.t: 好消息是，当失败发生时，我们会重新站起来，拍掉身上的灰尘，继续工作。

defs.def: land covered by small trees or bushes 灌木丛
the tail of a fox 狐狸尾巴
to clean, polish, or make smooth with a brush （用刷子）刷净，刷亮，刷平顺

ex.s: Needless to say, I didn't look forward to an entire term of being brushed off, but I tried to make the best of it and didn't say anything for fear that I would make things worse.
ex.t: 不用说，我并不期待整整一学期都被冷落，但我尽量随遇而安，什么也没说，怕把事情弄得更糟。

defs.def: to put sth, for example oil, milk or egg, on sth using a brush （用刷子）抹，涂

ex.s: There’s no better way to improve than to put in those brush miles.
ex.t: 没有比投入大量笔墨练习更好的提高方法了。

ex.s: brushed asideB. put to the test
ex.t: 把……撇在一边 B. 经受考验

defs.def: to remove sth from a surface with a brush or with your hand （用刷子或手）拂，掸，擦掉

ex.s: I brush it off and it runs under some leaves.
ex.t: 我把它拂开，它便钻到几片叶子下面去了。

defs.def: to touch sb/sth lightly while moving close to them/it 轻擦，掠过（某人/某物）

chunks.cn: 知道 大约 刷子
刷子 在…前 一个 来访者
